summary.en: The pipeline is concentrated in oncology, especially DXd antibody-drug conjugates. Merck partnerships support several lead ADCs and a DLL3 T-cell engager.
summary.zh: 管线集中于肿瘤领域,尤其是 DXd 抗体偶联药物(ADC)。与 Merck 的合作支持多个主要 ADC 和一款 DLL3 T 细胞接合器。

ind.en: Extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer; also prostate/esophageal cancer
ind.zh: 广泛期小细胞肺癌;另有前列腺癌/食管癌

next.zh: IDeate-Lung02 结果将在公司 2027 财年公布

ind.zh: HR 阳性/HER2 阴性乳腺癌

target.zh: DLL3 三特异性 T 细胞接合

ind.zh: 复发/难治性 B 细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤

ind.en: Systemic lupus erythematosus, including cutaneous lupus
ind.zh: 系统性红斑狼疮,包括皮肤型狼疮
联合 Enhertu 治疗 HER2 改变的实体瘤

watch.en: Three lead unapproved ADCs target B7-H3, HER3 and CDH6.
watch.zh: 三款主要的未获批 ADC 分别靶向 B7-H3、HER3 和 CDH6。

watch.en: The US ifinatamab BLA was voluntarily withdrawn in September 2026; Phase 3 trials continue.
watch.zh: 美国 ifinatamab 的 BLA 已于 2026 年 9 月自愿撤回;III 期试验仍在继续。

watch.en: Merck is the partner on I-DXd, HER3-DXd, R-DXd and gocatamig.
watch.zh: Merck 是 I-DXd、HER3-DXd、R-DXd 和 gocatamig 的合作伙伴。

watch.en: IDeate-Lung02 is expected to read out in fiscal 2027.
watch.zh: IDeate-Lung02 预计在 2027 财年公布结果。

sources: FY2026 Q2 reference data, October pipeline
